title: Netherite TNT Drops
description: Allows TNT explosions to break Ancient Debris and drop it normally.
body:
Finally, TNT can mine Ancient Debris.

Vanilla Minecraft prevents Ancient Debris from being destroyed by TNT, forcing players to mine every block by hand after large explosions.

Netherite TNT Drop changes that.

When Ancient Debris is caught in a TNT explosion, it now breaks and drops itself just like any other ore, making TNT mining a fast and satisfying way to search for Netherite.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Features
 TNT destroys Ancient Debris
 Ancient Debris drops as an item
 Lightweight with virtually no performance impact
 Multiplayer compatible
 Works in both singleplayer and dedicated servers
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 

Compatibility:
Minecraft 1.21.1
Fabric Loader
Client & Server required

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Perfect for:
Survival players
Multiplayer servers
Cobblemon modpacks
Vanilla+ modpacks
Anyone who enjoys TNT mining in the Nether

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

No unnecessary features. No gameplay overhaul.

Just one simple change that makes TNT mining for Netherite finally work the way many players expect.
